Comment: Everyone wants a villain to spice up a reality show but the viewers hardly vote to keep them but would rather vote to keep a perceived victim in the house! Last season,bbn organisers had set the ball rolling for a very exciting and unforgettable all star reality show by announcing that HMs could 'conspire' against fellow HMs....Pere,kidwaya,Ike and some other HMs had come up with a sinister but 'reality show' type of plan to take out illebaye and other female HMs perceived to be very strong through a DQ but that plan failed as most of the viewers who were normally emotional and ignorant pressured the organisers on SM to air the conspiracy on TV(though ike took his own villainess too far) and a reality show that was gearing up to be a competitive battle filled with the required vibes instantly died as all the guys in Pere's clique were taken out one by one except for him.....he had to retreat and decided to do what most naija viewers loved the most in a reality show by shipping with Mercy just to atleast give him the needed votes to be at the finals! Today we have HMs that have watched the show multiple times and know exactly what is required to sway the audience or viewers to their side! Some of them are the classic shipping with someone perceived to be very strong outside,purposely looking at the camera occasionally,creating false drama/fights,HMs strategically positioning themselves in spaces with a high probability of visibility etc This is why we might probably be having a somewhat slow and underwhelming show (though not forgetting that the harsh economy in Nigeria is also a contributing factor) Some of these HMs including the ones that have exited the show had the requirements to bring real drama and invoke lots of fights in the show but the question is who wants to be the ultimate villain of the show and get hated like the likes of Tacha or Ceecee when we know that most naija viewers,emotional and unaware of what is required of a reality show,will eventually swing towards the victim which will spur that HM to victory like illebaye? So why put all the blame on the production team when they simply gave you,the viewers, what you have always yearned for but later tagged it a borefest?😊😊

Comment: So, the internet has been buzzing about the fight between Rhuthie and the twins. Expectedly,  I have been reading some childish and biased comments here which I find very repulsive... Before I begin, let me categorically state that since BBN started, I haven't watched on TV, but get all my updates here which I find more entertaining than watching on TV. And from the updates, I am neither a fan of Rhuthie nor the twins. Hitherto, when I first saw the profile pictures of the twins, I liked them, but after watching some of their video clips, the likeness I had for them waned. So, the points I'm going to address is coming from an unbiased point of view.... Rhuthie called the twins "harlots" and some people have been getting overly excited and jumping out of their seats...The truth is, who comes to the BBN show as a saint? Is it Mercy who confessed about her numerous sexual escapades with men or Angel who made it clear that she bleeps for money? The list is endless and even Rhuthie is in the same WhatsApp group. Don't ask me how I know. The point I'm trying to pass across is, calling someone a harlot on a show like BBN is no insult at all; especially if it's coming from a single mother who is lusting after a boy young enough to be her kid brother. This is a case of a "runs girl" calling a roadside "prostitute" ashawo. And to those of you saying that the twins are too close...bla..bla..bla... Have you considered it could be one  of their strategies? The idea is to create a storyline that will keep Nigerians talking about them. Seemingly, it appears to be working and this brings me to the next point... The allegations of incest leveled against them is not only watery, but laughable. Unfortunately, some of you already bought the story and twisting it to suit your narratives. Where is the prove that the twins are sexually involved? It is not rocket science that when we are involved in an altercation with someone, we are at liberty to throw insults that are derogatory, and Rhuthie is "master of the game". I once had an altercation with a man and accused him of sleeping with his daughters just to humiliate him. There was a time I was triggered by a lady, and I told how she slept with a dog. She was left dumbfounded and couldn't even defend herself. So, I  am wondering why any reasonable person would believe what Rhuthie said without an iota of prove. And don't come with all that kissing shit that I have been reading here. I know families who show such affection amongst themselves, and if you don't do so, then take a back seat and watch others do it out of genuine love. Okay, let's even pretend they are in an incestuous relationship. Why would they want you to figure it out so easily when they are BBN addicts and know how judgemental Nigerians are? Sadly, many people are practicing incest and have devised a means to hide it. I don't think the  twins can be that dumb to throw it out like that when 100 Million is at stake. As for Wanni dating Shaun...If Mbeke Mercy who hides all her insecurity inside her designers wears could date Ike for his accent, then I see nothing wrong with Wanni dating Shaun for the same reason. I like Shaun, and there has been lots of rave reviews about him, but truthfully, there is nothing spectacular about the dude. I take a glimpse at him and still wondering whether having a UK accent is synonymous to being "posh". Perhaps it is, to the average Nigerian. And as for the twins... I think they came in with a bad strategy. Like I said earlier, I have watched some of their clips on YouTube which made me shudder. I have also hear them use some vulgar words on Rhuthie, which I find very repulsive. Obviously, they are low class girls and they need to work on themselves. Interestingly, the twins behave like the average Nigerian girl hustling for money on the Island. The difference is, they are more daring and unapologetic. I have a lot to say....but I am tired of typing. Oh! Let me digress a little: So, your favorite married couple had a daughter before they tied the knot? Hmnn....

Comment: So a lot of people have called this season out to be trash in many ramifications, and honestly speaking, I couldn't agree more. I believe there's a couple of things that can be done once this season is over to make the show look fresh, and feel more intense and highly competitive, while maintaining the spirit and vibes of Big Brother as a show, as well as letting us see more emotions and strategies from the housemate. I'm pretty much done with housemates coming to the house to eat, snooze, look pretty and do low effort or low stakes tasks, then come up with forced showmances. Money and prizes should be a luxury in that house and not something you are likely to get at least twice in a week. Now here are my pitches: - Go on a break for at least one or two or even three years, with the promise of a return. Hardcore fans will feel the show's absence and will be eagerly awaiting the show's resumption. Casual viewers, people who have lost interest, and even haters of the show will take notice of the show's absence. When the show returns, I believe it will be a major topic of the summer for a great portion of the population. The following changes to the game structure can then be made. - Encourage nominations to be discussed among the housemates throughout the season, not just a couple of weeks. Let the housemates talk in groups and come up with plans on who they want gone, whether for personal reasons or for game reasons. Let it become a part and parcel of the nomination process. Many people don't know the amount of drama that can be realized from this change alone lol. - Limit the number of housemates nominated every week to just three. I don't know why Biggie loves putting half the house on the block. With fewer people on the block, it will be a bit more clear who the house targets are, and with fewer targets or spots on the chopping block, the housemates will have to think strategically about who to nominate and why. We might be seeing more calculated moves and blindsides, making the game more exciting. - Following from my second point, there should be a tough competition among the nominated housemates and three other housemates selected by random draw on Wednesday every week, two days after the nomination ceremony. The winner will have the power to either save and replace a housemate with someone else on the block, or leave the nominations intact. Tactically genius housemates can exploit this to their advantage. Voting by the public will start on Wednesday night after the competition and close on Saturday night. - Introduce brand new twists that can stir up the pot and potentially even lead to conflict in the house in the early weeks. For instance, the recent face to face nominations that Biggie did was cool, but I honestly feel it would have produced a stronger effect in the house if it was done much earlier in week 1 or 2. Housemates are just getting to know each other in those weeks and a twist like that can set the tone for the nature of the relationships inside the house. Production should watch and learn from the British and Australian versions on how to implement creative twists to shake up the house. - Speaking of twists, they should try as much as possible to avoid twists from previous seasons of BBN. - Also, and this is just a personal annoyance of mine, I feel like the number of sponsored tasks are too many. Production should either reduce, or if you asked me, completely remove them. I prefer the BBA era where it was all about arena games and wagers. - With the exception of the wager (which Biggie should be making very difficult to win especially if the house wagers 100%), tasks in the house should always come close to putting the housemates on edge. Test their mental resolve, physicality, endurance, and even their trust in their fellow housemates. There are challenges designed to do just that. - Less table shaking from Ebuka. I feel like he does too much these days. Or even if he must, it shouldn't blow up anybody's game outrightly. He can make loose references without calling names, or ask interesting or ambiguous questions that can make people second-guess their strategies. - Let evicted housemates know who nominated them. For the life of me, I don't know why this element of the show was abandoned. It's another good setup for conflict when they want to do their reunion the following year. - I don't know if this is the case already but I feel like housemates who make it to the final week of the show should be guaranteed some cash as a reward, like a small fraction of the ultimate prize money. It will incentivize them to work harder to make the final five.

Comment: I have said it and I will keep saying it that most viewers are responsible for the borefest we are currently witnessing in BBN! Some said it's because of the custodian and immunity challenge brought by production team,my question is why didn't you vote for those pairs or HMs you felt would be entertaining...why wait until they got caught up with the custodian challenge? Some even said it was as a result of biggie's initial nomination pattern where HMs will nominate others during the live eviction show...what they fail to understand is that HMs only nominated pairs who were at the bottom and not pairs who were at the top ..this implies that if viewers really liked the flourish or streeze pair,they would have ensured that these pairs weren't around the bottom through votes! Finally,BBN is a business that listens to customers needs and act accordingly which is what we are currently witnessing on our screens! By the end of this season,most ardent viewers must be intentional about what is required from future HMs going forward. ..if U want the show to be entertaining and engaging from start to finish,keep HMs with villain prospects while chasing out delawoods with fine face but no content! For now,let's enjoy what we asked for😂😂

Comment: This is going to be a long write up as I dont usually commemt here. Please, bear with me. The truth about this show is that people believe what they want to believe and twist narratives to suit their beliefs. Coming to say that the only reason why people choose Doublekay is because they are married is ridiculous. I started gravitating towards them in week 3 as I do not like the way the projected winners at the time (the twins) shouts and look at the camera then before they act. They started growing on me though since week 2 cuz of the Toby/Kassia and Kelly/Dj Flo dynamics. Some people on this thread even said they will loose guard and their marriage will have issues so I wanted to see how that will play out. Wanni XHandi and the Shatoria pair are the only ones chosen on stage. I belive we will confirm this by the time Big brother releases the voting results for all the weeks. Now to the bandwagon thing, before DRC came into the house, Kellyrae was clear. Even on this thread, wanni supporters admitted that they have made peace with him winning. What made many people started gravitating towards her again was the way Dami pushed her and the narrative started flying that Big brother brought them to the house to get her disqualified. People also started decampaigning Kassia because she laughed. I know a lot of people that followed her that weekend because of that issue. If you doubt me, go to her Instagram page and see comments of "I'm new here, welcome me". Her numbers shot up drastically because it looked like she was being bullied which Nigerians dont like. Her fans asked the handler to put up that video with a pity sound playing at the background and that worked. Even one of wanni supporters here came here to say She has started topping on Facebook polls that was Kellyrae's ground before. Finally, to say Kellyrae brings absolutely nothing to the show is wicked. This guy probably has won most task in that house. As a duo, Doublekay has undoubtedly won most tasks which shows they are highly competitive. In a conversation with Shawn, Ocee and Topher, Shawn and Ocee said they are just winning everyting and Topher replied that they are the ones who own the show and the rest of the housemates just escorted them to the house. Thier strategy of not revealing their marital status to the house and keeping by it is the definition of no loose guard. It should not be downplayed in any way. Its a major talking point in all housemates interview. You think it's easy to spend that long time in that secluded place and not get caught even by your closest friends? Please, give them their flowers. Finally, all evicted housemates except Handi and Shawn have said their game is the best and rooted for them to win over Wanni. Even Handi and Shawn said they have the best strategy. They live with these people and cannot all be wrong. No matter what happens on.Sunday, they have played a good game and their efforts should not be reduced to its because they are married. Also if Wanni wins, its also fine. The funny thing is that the person that win has been written even before the kick off of the show and we just wish all of them success outside of the house which is the most important thing.
